tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Public company identity, hours, service area and payment methods.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Complete shared flat-rate repair catalog with descriptions, plus public service offerings.

tools.name: get_service_area
tools.description: Check a US ZIP against available public coverage data. ZIP boundaries and response-time estimates are not published; unknown is not a coverage denial. Includes the current EntityGraph city-guide list.

tools.name: get_current_offers
tools.description: Standing diagnostic policy and links for financing and ABA Home+ membership; no invented rates or eligibility guarantees.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Match a service or repair name to published flat-rate pricing. Ambiguous or absent matches return no price, never an estimate.

tools.name: get_recent_completions
tools.description: Recent public completed jobs, optionally by city. Returns only public job category, city, state, date and ID.

tools.name: get_technician_credentials
tools.description: Professional credentials, verified BBB accreditation and active dealer authorizations, plus published dealer awards. Unverified technician counts are explicitly unknown.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_technician_credentials" references sensitive artifacts (credentials, authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
